section.title: Staff
section.description: Active team members and open shifts.

addStaff.dialogDescription: Create a new staff account with a temporary PIN.
addStaff.successToast: {{name}} added — they'll be asked to set a new PIN on first login
addStaff.genericFailure: Something went wrong. Please try again or ask a manager for help.

resetPin.dialogDescription: Set a new 6-digit PIN for this staff member. They'll be required to change it on their next login.
resetPin.pinMismatch: PINs don't match — re-enter both fields.
resetPin.collisionWarning: This PIN is already in use by {{name}}. You can still continue, but consider choosing a different PIN.
resetPin.successToast: PIN reset for {{name}}. They'll be asked to set a new PIN at next login.
resetPin.genericFailure: Couldn't reset the PIN. Try again.
resetPin.partialFailureToast: PIN reset partially failed — the credential changed but the staff record didn't sync. Contact support before this staff member tries to log in.
